collection.label: Australian Consumer Law · Sydney / NSW coverage
collection.scope: Selected Commonwealth Australian Consumer Law provisions, applicable nationally including Sydney and NSW. State-only laws, council rules and practical complaint-handling guidance are outside this collection.

limitations: Development set only. Reference syntax, source presence and keywords do not measure factual correctness or entailment. Extractive mode does not judge answerability. Latency includes cold loading on the first applicable question.
